answer: The forge debit happens at intake, tundra totals the burned amount, and ferrous anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 4 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
